description: Ministerio de Vivienda y Ordenamiento Territorial de Panamá (MIVIOT) publishes 41 layers of the ministry geoportal: municipal territorial plans (POTs) of districts such as David, Las Tablas, Santiago, Bocas del Toro, Soná and Taboga defining land-use zones, urban standards, protected areas and infrastructure guidelines; the density of housing and population from the 2023 national census; the degree of urbanisation to 2030 (GHSL SMOD) by province and comarca; and the municipal planning boards. Coverage: Panama, national and by district; layers were published between July and September 2025. Format and access: CSV, shapefile and GeoJSON downloads plus ArcGIS REST feature services, without registration from the MIVIOT geoportal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): mixed: CC BY-NC 4.0 on the housing-density and urbanisation layers; the plan layers carry a notice allowing informational use only, with commercial use prohibited without MIVIOT authorisation and citation of MIVIOT required; cost: free. Caveats: the licence differs between layers and is non-commercial in every case read; the plan layers are tied to plans approved in different years (David in 2016) and may be out of date; the layer contents were not opened. Simulation uses: land-use and zoning scenarios, housing and population exposure for hazard models, and urban-growth inputs for infrastructure demand studies. Related catalogue records: Panama national open data catalogue (data-panama-national-open-data-catalogue); MIVIOT review of urbanisation plans in the construction stage, 2024 (Panama) (data-panama-miviot-urbanisation-plan-reviews-2024).
